Proverbs was written to give wisdom and understanding. What do you most need wisdom for?
"The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge." What does fearing the Lord mean to you?
The father warns his son about being enticed by sinners. What pressures from others do you face?
Wisdom calls out in the streets. Where do you hear wisdom calling you?
If you seek wisdom like silver, you will find the knowledge of God. How can you seek wisdom like treasure?
"The Lord gives wisdom." How do you ask God for wisdom?
Wisdom will guard you and deliver you from evil ways. How has wisdom protected you?
"Let not steadfast love and faithfulness forsake you." How can love and faithfulness mark your life?
"Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding." Where are you leaning on your own understanding?
"Honour the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits." How can you honour God with what you have?
"The Lord reproves him whom he loves." How has God's correction shown his love?
"Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due." Who could you do good to today?
The father urges his son to get wisdom above all. Why is wisdom worth more than anything?
"The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter." How is your path growing brighter?
"Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life." How can you guard your heart?
"Let your eyes look directly forward... Ponder the path of your feet." What distractions pull you off course?
The father warns against the seductive woman whose path leads to death. What attractive things lead us astray?
"Rejoice in the wife of your youth." How does faithfulness bring joy?
"A man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord." How does knowing God sees all affect your choices?
"Go to the ant, O sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise." What can you learn from the ant?
The Lord hates seven things, including a lying tongue and one who sows discord. Which do you need to watch for?
"The commandment is a lamp and the teaching a light." How does God's word light your way?
"Keep my commandments and live; keep my teaching as the apple of your eye." How can you treasure God's word?
The young man lacked sense and followed temptation step by step. How does temptation draw us in slowly?
"Let not your heart turn aside to her ways." How can you guard your heart against temptation?
Wisdom calls: "My fruit is better than gold." What makes wisdom so valuable?
"The fear of the Lord is hatred of evil." How does loving God shape what we hate?
Wisdom was beside God at creation, rejoicing. How does this help you see God's wisdom in the world?
"Whoever finds me finds life and obtains favour from the Lord." What does it mean to find wisdom?
Wisdom invites the simple to her feast. How do you respond to wisdom's invitation?
"Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser." How do you receive correction?
"The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom." How is your knowledge of God growing?
Folly also calls, offering stolen water. What false invitations do you hear?
"A wise son makes a glad father." How can your choices bring joy to others?
"Whoever walks in integrity walks securely." Why does integrity bring security?
"Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all offences." Whose offences can you cover with love?
"When words are many, transgression is not lacking, but whoever restrains his lips is prudent." When should you speak less?
"The integrity of the upright guides them." How does integrity guide your decisions?
"In an abundance of counsellors there is safety." Who gives you wise counsel?
"Whoever brings blessing will be enriched, and one who waters will himself be watered." How does generosity bless the giver?
"Whoever captures souls is wise." How can you lead others toward life?
"Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge." How do you respond to correction?
"The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to advice." Whose advice do you need to hear?
"The tongue of the wise brings healing." How can your words bring healing?
"Anxiety in a man's heart weighs him down, but a good word makes him glad." Who could you encourage today?
"Whoever guards his mouth preserves his life." How do your words affect your life?
"Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life." What are you hoping for?
"Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise." Who are you walking with?
Proverbs links love with discipline. How does loving discipline help children grow?
"There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death." Where might you be trusting your own judgement too much?
"In the fear of the Lord one has strong confidence." Where does your confidence come from?
"Whoever is slow to anger has great understanding... A tranquil heart gives life to the flesh." How can you grow in patience?
"Whoever is generous to the needy honours God." How can you honour God through generosity?
"A soft answer turns away wrath." When could a gentle answer help you this week?
"The eyes of the Lord are in every place." How does God's presence everywhere affect your choices?
"Better is a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble with it." What do you truly value?
"Without counsel plans fail, but with many advisers they succeed." Who could you ask for advice?
"Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established." What plans can you commit to God?
"The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his steps." How have you seen God direct your steps?
"Pride goes before destruction." Where might pride be creeping in?
"Gracious words are like a honeycomb, sweetness to the soul." Who could you speak gracious words to?
"Whoever is slow to anger is better than the mighty." How can you grow in self-control?
"Better is a dry morsel with quiet than a house full of feasting with strife." What brings peace to a home?
"Whoever covers an offence seeks love." When is it loving to let something go?
"A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity." Who has been this kind of friend to you?
"A joyful heart is good medicine." What brings joy to your heart?
"The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous man runs into it and is safe." Where do you run when afraid?
"If one gives an answer before he hears, it is his folly." How can you listen better?
"Death and life are in the power of the tongue." How can your words give life?
"There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother." How does Jesus fit this description?
"Good sense makes one slow to anger, and it is his glory to overlook an offence." What offence could you overlook?
"Whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord." How does this change how you see giving?
"Many are the plans in the mind of a man, but it is the purpose of the Lord that will stand." How do you hold your plans?
"It is an honour for a man to keep aloof from strife." How can you avoid unnecessary conflict?
"Who can say, 'I have made my heart pure; I am clean from my sin'?" What does this show about our need for grace?
"Do not say, 'I will repay evil'; wait for the Lord, and he will deliver you." How can you leave justice to God?
"A man's steps are from the Lord." How does this help you trust God's guidance?
"The king's heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord." What does this show about God's sovereignty?
"To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice." What does God value most?
"Whoever closes his ear to the cry of the poor will himself call out and not be answered." How can you listen to the poor?
"The victory belongs to the Lord." Where do you need to remember this?
"A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches." What does a good name mean to you?
"Train up a child in the way he should go." How can you help a child grow in faith?
"Whoever has a bountiful eye will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the poor." Who could you share with?
The sayings aim "that your trust may be in the Lord." How does wisdom lead to trust?
"Do not toil to acquire wealth... it sprouts wings, flying like an eagle." How do you hold money?
"Let not your heart envy sinners, but continue in the fear of the Lord all the day." Where are you tempted to envy?
"My son, give me your heart." What would it mean to give your heart to God's wisdom?
"By wisdom a house is built." How can you build your home with wisdom?
"Rescue those who are being taken away to death." Who needs rescuing that you could help?
"Do not rejoice when your enemy falls." How can you show grace even to enemies?
"A little sleep, a little slumber... and poverty will come upon you." Where might you be neglecting what matters?
"A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in a setting of silver." Who needs a fitting word from you?
"If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat." How can you show kindness to someone against you?
"Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country." What good news refreshes you?
"A man without self-control is like a city broken into and left without walls." Where do you need self-control?
Proverbs says both "Answer not a fool" and "Answer a fool." How do you discern when to speak and when to stay silent?
"Do you see a man who is wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him." How can you guard against pride?
"For lack of wood the fire goes out, and where there is no whisperer, quarrelling ceases." How can you stop gossip?
"Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring." How can you hold your plans humbly?
"Faithful are the wounds of a friend." Who loves you enough to tell you hard truths?
"Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another." Who sharpens you in your faith?
"The righteous are bold as a lion." Where do you need boldness?
"Whoever conceals his transgressions will not prosper, but he who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy." What do you need to confess?
"Whoever gives to the poor will not want." How can you trust God as you give?
"A fool gives full vent to his spirit, but a wise man quietly holds it back." How can you handle anger wisely?
"Where there is no prophetic vision the people cast off restraint, but blessed is he who keeps the law." How does God's word give direction?
"The fear of man lays a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is safe." Where does fear of others trap you?
"Every word of God proves true; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him." How does God's word protect you?
Agur prays, "Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food that is needful for me." What does contentment look like for you?
Small creatures like ants and spiders are exceedingly wise. What can small things teach you?
"Open your mouth for the mute... defend the rights of the poor and needy." How can you speak up for others?
The woman of strength works with willing hands and opens her hand to the poor. Which of her qualities inspires you?
"Strength and dignity are her clothing... she opens her mouth with wisdom." How can you clothe yourself with strength and dignity?
"Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain, but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised." What does God value most?
